The core challenge is extracting precise play-by-play from noisy broadcast video. Pure vision fails due to high false-positive rates at recall. The tactical denoiser leverages game-state priors to prune noise, enabling high-recall automated spotting. This is an optimal filtering problem: noisy visual detections are measurements, game-state features are hidden variables, and the prior is the transition model. The paradigm generalizes to NFL by replacing soccer tactics with American football formations and rules.
